title: Everyday Phrases — At the Pharmacy
scene_zh: 去藥局買藥 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, I need help with a cold.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💊 實用的去藥局買藥必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Pharmacy
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的去藥局買藥情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從描述感冒發燒症狀、詢問劑量與副作用、選購維他命與體溫計到回家按時服藥，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Pharmacy phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the full journey: describing cold and fever symptoms, asking about doses and side effects, picking vitamins and a thermometer, and taking medicine on schedule at home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need help with a cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪ nid hɛlp wɪð ə koʊld./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a sore throat today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it hurt when you swallow?
dialogue.zh: 你吞東西的時候會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and I cough a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long have you had this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a fever too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a little behind my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is your nose stuffy at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I breathe through my mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still have an old prescription.
dialogue.zh: 我手上還有一張舊處方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When did the doctor write it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is from two years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你能打電話給我醫生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we can try calling now.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們現在就試著打給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I need a new one.
dialogue.zh: 所以我得先開一張新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，那種強度高的藥需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can I buy without one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many safe options help a lot.
dialogue.zh: 很多安全的成藥也很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些是架上直接賣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，這層架子上的都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My body aches when I walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I see a doctor today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is a fever too high?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 超過三十九度就聯絡醫生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell something for fever?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，對乙醯氨基酚或布洛芬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before that, I have some allergies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, what are you allergic to?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 盤尼西林會讓我起疹子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 記下了，還有別的不舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I take pills for blood pressure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you take them every morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me that box if you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðæt bɑks ɪf ju kæn./
dialogue.zh: 方便的話，把那盒藥拿給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我忘記藥的確切名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can cold medicine mix with it?
dialogue.zh: 感冒藥可以和它一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will pick a safe one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat is worst in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θroʊt ɪz wɜrst ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? How do I do that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stir half a spoon of salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gargle it, then spit it out?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my voice is gone too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Speak softly for a few days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，濕潤的空氣能舒緩喉嚨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 先買咳嗽藥還是喉嚨的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩個一起顧，常一起出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have something for congestion?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These tablets clear a blocked nose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這款也能緩解那些不適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these safe with my other pill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz seɪf wɪð maɪ ˈʌðər pɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 這跟我那顆血壓藥搭配安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這種不會跟你的血壓藥相衝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a little dizzy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His neck feels warm to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡賣電子體溫計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those easy for a child?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好，電池已經裝在裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my son rest at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep him home from school.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long must he stay away?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A day after the fever ends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I get for him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I suggest a fever tablet first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is gentle and very common.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every six hours, max four doses.
dialogue.zh: 每六小時一次，最多四次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take two tablets now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take it before meals?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is gentler on a full stomach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈdʒɛntələr ɑn ə fʊl ˈstʌmək./
dialogue.zh: 胃裡有食物時，藥性比較溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I forget a dose?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跳過就好，千萬別吃雙倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, wait until the next time.
dialogue.zh: 對，等下一次的時間再到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this syrup help my cough?
dialogue.zh: 這罐糖漿對我的咳嗽有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，它能止咳讓你好過些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要日間糖漿還是夜間糖漿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 夜間的那種能幫你入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the night one make me sleepy?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə naɪt wʌn meɪk mi ˈslipi?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼夜間那款會讓我想睡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這股睏意正好幫你入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to feel so sleepy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tu fil soʊ ˈslipi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not drive after taking it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee is fine in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm tea actually helps a lot.
dialogue.zh: 溫熱的茶其實很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我其他的藥還能一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把你所有在用的都給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days for the fever?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it until the fever drops.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long before I feel better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should feel better by tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 明天開始你就會好一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I also take cough medicine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要，這瓶粉紅色的很有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the dose for adults?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How full should the cup be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這支餵藥針筒上有刻度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I just guess the amount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小孩的藥量絕對不能猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this syrup for his cough?
dialogue.zh: 這罐糖漿是給他止咳的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often for my little boy?
dialogue.zh: 我家小子要多久喝一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每八小時一次，不能更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he take fever medicine too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，要兒童配方那一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 成人的退燒藥對小孩太強嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never give adult pills to him.
dialogue.zh: 千萬不要把成人的藥給他吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if he spits it out?
dialogue.zh: 如果他喝了又吐出來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the syrup need the fridge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a cool shelf is fine.
dialogue.zh: 不用，放在陰涼的架子上就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What side effects should I watch?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the night syrup okay for kids?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə naɪt ˈsɪrəp oʊˈkeɪ fər kɪdz?/
dialogue.zh: 夜間糖漿小孩也能喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，選不會想睡的那款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 不嗜睡的那款能止咳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cough is worse at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I sleep well with the night syrup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ slip wɛl wɪð ðə naɪt ˈsɪrəp?/
dialogue.zh: 喝了夜間糖漿我能睡得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 吃了這些會腸胃不適嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先吃點東西就能減少刺激。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，喝酒會讓你更嗜睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For how many days in total?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the fever comes back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the doctor that same day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I take an extra dose at midnight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ teɪk ən ˈɛkstrə doʊz ət ˈmɪdˌnaɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，兩次間隔要六小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gee, I work the night shift.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上班前吃不嗜睡的款式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these tablets treat a sore throat?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈtæbləts trit ə sɔr θroʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 這些藥錠能醫喉嚨痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I eat after a lozenge?
dialogue.zh: 含完喉片可以吃東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a hot bath tonight okay?
dialogue.zh: 今晚我可以泡熱水澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，蒸氣能讓胸口舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is a lot to remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the times on this card.
dialogue.zh: 把吃的時間寫在這張卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will post it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or post it on the fridge door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr poʊst ɪt ɑn ðə frɪdʒ dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell face masks here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 藍色那盒戴起來很貼臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these good for sick people?
dialogue.zh: 生病的人戴這種合適嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, especially for your son.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，特別是為了你兒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you carry vitamin C here?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡有維他命 C 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我兒子很討厭大顆藥錠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這橘色的咀嚼錠味道很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 咀嚼錠的效果一樣好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 效果一樣，每天早上吃一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 維他命 D 也有用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is good for winter days.
dialogue.zh: 在寒冷的冬天對身體有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那維他命 D 很適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right next to the syrups.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you put it on?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it help the cough too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它的蒸氣能讓鼻子通暢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this balm safe for kids?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then get me one small jar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this scent is gentle too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the first aid section?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 繃帶創可貼就在口罩旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This tube is for sore muscles.
dialogue.zh: 這條藥膏是給肌肉痠痛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub a little on at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有剛擦上的第一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I use it on my son?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ juz ɪt ɑn maɪ sʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以擦在我兒子身上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩歲以下的小孩不能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is five, so that is okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz faɪv, soʊ ðæt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay by card here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, do you have your card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I brought my insurance card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那項要自己付現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have our membership card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會員會收到折價券訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有時會，是冬天藥品的優惠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how much is it now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With both, it is eighteen twenty.
dialogue.zh: 含保險和會員折扣，是十八塊二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, could I have a bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cold ones are by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊld wʌnz ɑr baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water helps me take my pills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take one right now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在就可以先吃一顆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, this tablet is so big.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，這顆藥錠真的好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have cough drops too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜口味的那款很受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tissue box, where is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，對擦紅的鼻子很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們有生理食鹽水噴劑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it clears out the nose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 食鹽水噴劑對小孩安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 鼻塞的夜裡選它很剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, keep it safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I need it for insurance.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the receipt is in your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, ðə rɪˈsit ɪz ɪn jɔr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 想得周到，收據已經放在袋子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two syrups and all the tablets?
dialogue.zh: 兩瓶糖漿和所有藥錠都在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back home, we read the labels.
dialogue.zh: 回到家，我們核對藥瓶標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us write the times down.
dialogue.zh: 我們把吃藥時間寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use this fridge card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the fever is coming down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it down with the time.
dialogue.zh: 把讀數和時間一起記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the chart now.
dialogue.zh: 我已經寫在記錄表上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check again before going to bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep the window closed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is sweating through his shirt.
dialogue.zh: 他出汗把衣服都濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 幫他換掉，保持身體乾爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 發燒代表身體在對抗病毒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about some juice for him?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他的咳嗽聽起來比較有痰了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the bottle say shake?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每次喝之前都要搖一搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us keep the syrup on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kip ðə ˈsɪrəp ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should medicine stay in the fridge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the label says so.
dialogue.zh: 只有標籤特別說明才要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep all boxes out of reach.
dialogue.zh: 所有藥品都要放拿不到的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 小孩子不應該翻到藥錠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兒童安全蓋每次都要轉緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do we do with leftovers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the date, then keep the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə deɪt, ðɛn kip ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 先確認效期，再決定留不留。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the date is printed here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在瓶身寫上今天的日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 開封的糖漿只能放一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We could bring them to the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊd brɪŋ ðɛm tu ðə stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把它們拿到藥局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，他們會回收過期藥品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still have last winter's pills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They still look fine to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 但它們也許已經不安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, my cough is not better.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的咳嗽沒有好轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many days did you take it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz dɪd ju teɪk ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has been three full days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night, the fever came back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a stronger one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my old prescription still work?
dialogue.zh: 我那張舊處方還可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，那一張已經過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a doctor near here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clinic is two blocks away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I tell the doctor?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每次量到的都記錄得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 醫生最愛這種書面記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These masks are the wrong size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I did not open them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One moment, I will process it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ointment tube is open, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過那條藥膏已經拆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們有更小尺寸的口罩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These are the smallest we sell.
dialogue.zh: 這已經是我們最小的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son outgrew his old ones.
dialogue.zh: 我兒子長大了，舊口罩戴不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last question about the syrup.
dialogue.zh: 關於糖漿的最後一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my son still take his?
dialogue.zh: 我兒子還能接著喝他那瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你幫我們樣樣確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get well soon, both of you.
dialogue.zh: 祝你們兩人都早日康復。
